character.momo: Momo, a chubby round baby bunny, soft cream-white fur, oversized floppy ears with pale pink inner ears, huge sparkly dark eyes, small pink nose, rosy cheeks, mint-green overalls with two small yellow buttons on the shoulder straps, big expressive smile
character.ducky: Ducky, a tiny round yellow duckling with an orange beak, no clothes
rules: 의상·색·비율을 바꾸지 말 것. 우비 등은 멜빵바지 위에 덧입힌다.
노란 멜빵 단추(양쪽 2개)는 항상 보이게 — 씬 간 일관성 시그니처. (원 지시서는 '단추 하나'였으나 모델이 3회 연속 2개로 그려 1차 시트를 승인, 2026-09-29 사용자 결정)
조연(Ducky·Toto·Sunny)은 필요한 에피소드에서만. 이빨·날카로운 발톱 등 무서운 요소 금지.
Toto 의 주황 반다나, Sunny 의 산호색 별 무늬는 항상 보이게 (씬 간 식별 표식).
character.croc: Toto, a chubby round baby crocodile, soft lime-green body with a pale yellow belly, short rounded snout with no visible teeth, big round friendly eyes, tiny stubby legs, small soft rounded bumps on the back, a small orange bandana tied around the neck
character.shark: Sunny, a chubby round baby shark, soft lavender-blue body with a white belly, small rounded fins, big sparkly eyes, rosy cheeks, a gentle closed-mouth smile with no teeth, a small coral-orange star-shaped mark on the forehead
character.octo: Inko, a chubby round baby octopus, bright grape-purple body with pale lilac spots, eight short curly tentacles, big mischievous eyes behind a tiny black bandit eye-mask, a sly closed-mouth smirk with no teeth, rosy cheeks
villain_rules: 잉코(문어)는 장난꾸러기 악당: 물건 숨기기·먹물 장난 정도. 위협·공격·무서운 표정·어두운 조명 금지.
매 에피소드 끝에는 잘못을 깨닫거나 화해 (2~5세용). 검은 도둑 눈가면은 식별 표식으로 항상 보이게.
character.momo_reinforce: both long floppy ears always hang down beside the cheeks, the ears never stand upright

style_lock: bright saturated 3D cartoon animation style, Pixar-like soft rounded shapes, clean simple background, one focal object per shot, eye-level or slightly low camera, soft even lighting, full-bleed edge-to-edge, no border, no frame, no vignette, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks
video_prompt_suffix: Keep the character design exactly the same. Static fixed camera, no camera movement, no zoom, no morphing, gentle small motion only.

en.outro: Bye-bye, friends! See you next time!
